newsitem.title: UK: Odds cut on British election in May-bookmakers.
newsitem.headline: Odds cut on British election in May-bookmakers.

text.p: The odds on the British election taking place in May were cut to 1-3 from 4-5, bookmakers William Hill said on Friday.
April was quoted at 11-4 with March at 5-1 and February at 100-1.
Labour are 1-4 favourites to win the election with the ruling Conservatives at 5-2 and the Liberal Democrats at 400-1.
William Hill said they were offering 3-1 on a hung parliament -- where no party has a majority -- and 12-1 on a second election taking place during 1997.
